reading.body:
CyrusOne Sterling (NVA4) is a small published data center in Virginia's disclosed capacity set, with 11 MW of IT load, 0.7% of the state's 1,603 MW.

The facility ranks 22nd among the 25 Virginia data centers that publish capacity figures, and its 128,715 square feet of technical space is large relative to that 11 MW load. That points to a conventional colocation build, not the high-density compute halls that drive AI training demand. For AI scaling, this site is not among the infrastructure that shapes near-term power or building bottlenecks in Virginia.

What the data does not show is whether NVA4 can expand. Grid supply, interconnection queue position, and operator capital plans are not published, and the facility lists no certifications. Its suitability score of 57 rests only on published IT capacity and operator type, with announced expansion missing, so it cannot support a claim about future AI capacity.

suitability.basis: weighted mean of the published inputs named here, scaled to 100; formula on the methodology page
